cuts.line: The club I feel most confident with is my 7-iron.
(no talking: the tee shot, ball tracer into the trees)
Well, I did get over all the chunky stuff. I guess I just forgot to tell myself to also have a good shot.
I feel no worries about these guys being on the green because I've never hit 188 with 7-iron in my life.
Technically that was a safe play, it was a bad play, it was a bad shot, I'm a bad golfer.
Is it possible? I wouldn't personally bet any money on it at this point in time.
I know when we started this venture I was all like let's break 50, let's break 50, I'm only gonna use my 7-iron. I'm really good with my 7-iron.
We're not even close to 50, I don't think. Breaking 60 might have been a better goal.
